The `m3e-menu` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Basic usage

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
[ M3e.Component.Button.button [] [ M3e.Component.MenuTrigger.menutrigger [ M3e.Component.MenuTrigger.for "menu1" ] [ TypedHtml.text "Menu" ] ]
, M3e.Component.Menu.menu [ M3e.Attributes.id "menu1" ]
[ M3e.Component.MenuItem.menuitem [] [ TypedHtml.text "Item 1" ]
, M3e.Component.MenuItem.menuitem [] [ TypedHtml.text "Item 2" ]
]
]
[ M3e.Component.Button.component
{ content = M3e.Component.MenuTrigger.menutrigger [ M3e.Component.MenuTrigger.for "menu1" ] [ TypedHtml.text "Menu" ]
, action = M3e.Action.none
}
[]
[]
, M3e.Component.Menu.menu [ M3e.Attributes.id "menu1" ]
[ M3e.Component.MenuItem.menuitem [] [ TypedHtml.text "Item 1" ]
, M3e.Component.MenuItem.menuitem [] [ TypedHtml.text "Item 2" ]
]
]

build is identical to the M3e tab for this example — its content has no required slots or attributes for the build surface to enforce, so it would be a hollow duplicate of M3e. Reach for build on an example whose composition it can hold a guarantee over.

<m3e-button>
<m3e-menu-trigger for="menu1">Menu</m3e-menu-trigger>
</m3e-button>
<m3e-menu id="menu1">
<m3e-menu-item>Item 1</m3e-menu-item>
<m3e-menu-item>Item 2</m3e-menu-item>
</m3e-menu>

API

Types

type Is

The kind row m3e-menu produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Content

The kinds the default slot admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

type PositionX

The positionX values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

type PositionY

The positionY values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

type Variant

The variant values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

type Builder
type AttrCaps
type SlotCaps

Motion durations and state-layer opacities — raw CSS custom property overrides for the 16 transition-timing tokens and 3 interaction-state opacity tokens @m3e/web exposes.

CSS Variables

Non-color @m3e/web CSS custom properties (typescale, shape, motion, state), grouped by name hierarchy. Color tokens are in the Color section above. Type a value to override it; clear to revert. (Live default values aren't shown — Elm can't read computed CSS variables.)
